CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
